goal: Inspect the lineage and inheritance values already recorded in the selected running career, without taking an action or reconstructing missing facts.
sourceFence: new InheritancePanel.tsx, inheritanceView.ts and scoped CSS
optional snapshot mirror fields in api/types.ts
single App import and placement after AptitudePanel
new focused maintained test entry and receiving documentation
preserve: all native engine, catalog and RNG source
predicates: Show all six explicit ancestor positions and every retained spark occurrence without merging duplicates, inventing parent relationships for flat entries, defaulting missing stars, or clamping recorded values.
Show native-retained parent names, factor IDs, cap additions, starting-stat bonuses and inheritance-choice/inspiration progress from the supplied legacy record; compute no bonuses or future odds.
Use catalog names only for exact factor IDs, retain literal IDs and unknown values, and render markup-like names as text.
Distinguish an empty recorded tree/collection from unavailable data; present flat-only entries literally without parsing an ancestry or adding stars.
Replacing the supplied career and catalogs replaces all displayed facts; no local record cache may retain the previous career.
Opening and closing disclosures or scrolling the panel sends no API request, changes no source snapshot, and modifies no persisted session/checkpoint.
Actual structured and flat native careers provide the baseline absence and candidate evidence; ordinary native continuation keeps recorded lineage while updating only native-owned state.
Inspect desktop and 390px layouts, keyboard disclosure operation and full current TypeScript/Vite compatibility using installed dependencies.
Preserve every current package source byte outside the declared source fence and keep the original staging capacity refusal separate from product findings.
nativeExecution: Private fixture/output locations only; current existing runtime and explicit source-bound producer receipts; no dependency install or player-save changes.
